name: US immigration: INA, USCIS Policy Manual, FAM, BIA precedent
_doc: Load ALONGSIDE us-federal, never instead of it. This pack adds the citation systems that are specific to immigration practice; the CFR and U.S. Code shapes those citations resolve into live in the base pack.
_official_domains: The agencies this pack's citations resolve to. Merged into the review grounding so `uscis.com` - the exact agency name in a foreign zone, measured walking past a labels-only detector - is flagged for a human. Registrable domains only: `travel.state.gov` is already covered by `state.gov` for suffix purposes, and deriving `travel` as a name would put a warning on `travel.com`. 🔴 `ice.gov` is left out ON PURPOSE: `ice` is an English word and a whole-label match on it would flag a commodities exchange and half of Iceland; ICE pages still classify as official through the `.gov` suffix - only the name-impersonation warning is not extended to it.

aliases._doc: An INA section and a U.S. Code section are the same provision under two numbering systems. Without this table `INA 245` and `8 U.S.C. 1255` are simply different addresses, and a correct pincite reads as a mismatch. In the original project exactly one reviewer of four supplied this; the other three missed it.

file_match._what: 🔴 The part letter is load-bearing, not decoration. Volume 7 part A chapter 8 and volume 7 part B chapter 8 are DIFFERENT chapters that share a number, and in one real case they held opposite propositions. If the file's own header names a part and it is not ours, reject before any other test.

shapes._what: 9 FAM 302.8 — State Department Foreign Affairs Manual. A DIFFERENT standard from the USCIS manual on the same subject, not a duplicate of it.
